verdict.rationale: First-party docs confirm Proton Pass generates TOTP codes for saved logins, and a community user relies on it for all their 2FA, so the TOTP-generation core is delivered. Nothing in the evidence shows QR-code scanning as the setup path, and one user notes integrated TOTP comes with paid plans (Pass Plus/Unlimited), which limits the 'immediately' part for everyday users. Missing for 10: evidence of QR-code scanning to enroll a TOTP secret, documentation of the setup flow and its speed, and clarity on free-tier availability.
